dogecoin.text: So much for that #Dogecoin rally, $DOGE -10% after losing about half of its value over the weekend after Elon Musk referred to the crypto as a "hustle" during his SNL appearance.  Way to be an evangelist Elon.

@dmitchinson @elonmusk Dogecoin for sure is getting crushed because of that, but $TSLA is likely getting hit with the broader tech selloff, on future inflation worries. But sure, some of it could be from Musk's appearance.
And just like that #Cryptos turn green late in the day after $BTC $DOGE $ETH were down double digits earlier.  No help for $TSLA -2.5%
We're about due for an @elonmusk tweet favoring cryptos, as we see double digit declines for #Bitcoin, $ETH and $DOGE.  $TSLA -3.8% given the firm's $1.5B investment in Bitcoin

Looks like another fun day ahead for #cryptos w @elonmusk spending the weekend on Twitter ripping $BTC -7%, although claiming $TSLA -1.8% hasn't sold any of its $1.5B stake in Bitcoin.   $DOGE -3% $ETH -5%
The #crypto selloff is picking up speed with #bitcoin down 23%.  $DOGE -44% https://t.co/1b2mEZeQVy
Are you still hanging on to your #crypto holdings?  #bitcoin -23% and falling fast, $ETH -34%  $DOGE -41%.
$BTC about to turn red, $DOGE down 4% after being UP over 40% earlier today. Must be fun trading on that kinda volatility.
$TSLA +3.4% and $NFLX +2% boosting the #NASDAQ +160 while #cryptos rally 20% higher on the latest Elon Musk tweet about $DOGE +24%
@elonmusk has become the modern day version of those old EF Hutton commercials.  $BTC $DOGE $ETH all up more than 20% after tweeting "Who's that Doge in the window"
#Crypto is living and dying on @elonmusk tweets. Everyone loves #crypto today after this. $DOGE +41% $BTC +21%.
Happy Friday everyone, market looking to rally for the second straight day with treasury yields easing lower.  #Crypto is sliding lower with 6% declines for $ETH and $DOGE
#Elon can't help himself. $BTC -8% on this little nugget, although his fave $DOGE -15% is taking an even bigger beating.
@dougboneparth I got some bad info. I thought you got one Shrute Buck for every $DOGE.

$HOOD -7.7% after missing Q3 revenue estimates, with the stock trading app taking a hit from a drop in crypto trading activity after a record in Q2.  Robinhood didn't divulge $DOGE activity after it made up 62% of its Q2 crypto revenue.
